headings.usage: H1, H2, H3, large editorial text. Use elegant tracking (tracking-tight for large text).

body.usage: Paragraphs, UI elements, buttons, small text.

accent.usage: Used sparingly for decorative brand moments, quotes, or subheadings.

visual_enhancers.borders: Thin, delicate borders (1px solid #E8D8D8). Fine dotted separators for editorial feel.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Very soft, diffused shadows (shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)]). Only use on hover or for floating elements.
visual_enhancers.border_radius: Subtle rounded corners (rounded-md or rounded-lg) for images. Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for buttons and badges.
visual_enhancers.motifs: Include small SVGs for bow/sparkle/floral motifs sparingly as dividers or next to headers.
visual_enhancers.gradients: Very subtle, low-opacity linear gradients (e.g., from #FAF8F5 to #FADADD/20) for section backgrounds, avoiding generic SaaS gradients.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped. Primary: bg-[#592C32] text-[#FAF8F5] hover:bg-[#2E1C1E]. Secondary: bg-[#FADADD] text-[#592C32] hover:bg-[#DCAEAF].
components.cards: Cardless approach preferred. Use raw divs with thin borders or just spacing. If using cards, use no background or #FFFFFF, 1px border, no shadow until hover.
components.inputs: Shadcn inputs customized: bg-transparent, border-b only (or thin full border), rounded-none or rounded-sm, focus:border-[#592C32] focus:ring-0.
components.announcement_bar: bg-[#DCAEAF] text-[#FAF8F5] text-sm py-2 text-center tracking-wide font-body.
components.whatsapp_float: Fixed bottom-right. Pill shape with WhatsApp icon. bg-[#25D366] text-white OR bg-[#FADADD] text-[#592C32] depending on contrast needs.

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous. Use py-20 or py-24 for main sections. p-8 or p-12 for internal padding.
grids_and_layouts.hero: Editorial split-screen or large immersive image with max 30% overlay. Text box offset, overlapping image slightly.
grids_and_layouts.product_grid: Asymmetrical or classic 4-col with plenty of whitespace. Image aspect ratio 4:5 (portrait) is mandatory for jewellery.
grids_and_layouts.bento: Avoid rigid bento boxes. Favor free-flowing editorial layouts (masonry or staggered grids) for 'Her Favourites' or 'About' sections.

motion.hover: Images: scale-105 with long transition (duration-500). Buttons: subtle transform -translate-y-0.5.
motion.scroll: Fade in and slight slide up (framer-motion) for sections. Smooth scrolling via Lenis.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has sufficient contrast or a subtle gradient overlay.
accessibility.aria: Include aria-labels for icon-only buttons (like WhatsApp, Cart).
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings on inputs, using the brand accent color.

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT USE INTER, ROBOTO, OR PLAYFAIR DISPLAY. Rely strictly on Cormorant Garamond (headings), Manrope (body), and Italiana (accents).
All components must be written in .js/.jsx, not .tsx. Do not include TypeScript interfaces or type annotations in the generated code.
Avoid generic Shopify layouts. Build a Pinterest-inspired editorial layout. Ensure overlapping text/image combinations, off-grid alignment, and generous spacing.
Do not over-decorate. Use subtle pinks (#FADADD, #DCAEAF) mainly as backgrounds or hovers. Reserve Burgundy (#592C32) for high-contrast elements like typography and primary buttons.
Use Lucide-React for standard icons, but try to use custom soft SVG motifs for the bow/sparkle elements.
Implement Shadcn UI carefully by stripping away its default SaaS 'Vercel' look. Soften the borders, change the ring colors, and ensure forms look like high-end boutique forms.
Ensure the Admin Dashboard uses the same typography but a denser layout suitable for functionality. Keep the dashboard light and clean, avoiding harsh dark sidebars if possible.
Include a Floating WhatsApp button on the bottom right.
Every section MUST feel emotionally directed, using close-up product imagery and negative space.
DO NOT use a complete transparent background in the header, overlays, or any surface that has content under it. Example: Dropdown with transparent background is forbidden.
universal_guidelines: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing. Example: data-testid='add-to-cart-button'.
